facts.claim: Jewel of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 2004; 90,050 GT; 2150 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Radiance class.

Jewel of the Seas delivers some of the world’s most desired destinations.  This cruise ship is packed with vibrant onboard experiences and dining venues. Discover new shores and countless adventures in between.
Wander to the world’s most captivating destinations onboard Jewel of the Seas®.
GTS Jewel of the Seas is a Radiance-class cruise ship operated by Royal Caribbean.

catalogSpecs.description: Radiance-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2004; 90,050 GT; approx. 2,150 guests at double occupancy.
